prompt: A MongoDB query for recent unresolved alerts scans most of a 20M-document collection for one high-volume tenant. Candidate indexes differ in tenant/status/time ordering and one low-cardinality field tempts a poor prefix. Capture actual query shapes/selectivity, choose and validate a compound index, measure read/write/storage effects, and verify sort coverage plus neighboring query regressions under representative tenant skew.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual mongodb-engineering boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=backend-engineering; near-neighbor=relational-data-modeling), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Model documents around ownership, atomic update boundaries, cardinality, growth, and dominant access patterns.
Index order is justified by actual predicates/sort/selectivity and representative skew; improvement must include measured cost to writes/storage and neighboring queries.
Inspect explain plans and index coverage, test document growth and migration, concurrent updates, transaction/retry behavior, read/write concern, and representative aggregation cardinalities.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not model every relation as embedded, use unbounded arrays, add indexes without write/storage cost analysis, or assume eventual consistency is acceptable without a product contract.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (mongodb-engineering decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
